title: Rabbi Yonatan ben Asmai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Asmai. (In Ein Yaakov: ben Akhmai; in Dikdukei Soferim: ben Chakhmai; and in Tanchuma, Bereshit 13, the reading is ben Akhmai.) He was a disciple of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, as in Moed Katan 9a: Rabbi Yonatan ben Asmi and Rabbi Yehuda ben Gerim studied the section on vows in the house of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai. [They] said to him (א״ל), 'Our master, you have taught us.' Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai said to his son, 'These people are men of stature; go to them that they may bless you.'

And he went to them and they blessed him: 'May it be His will that you sow and not reap, that you bring in and not take out, that your house be laid waste and your lodging be settled, that your table be thrown into confusion, and that you not see a new year.' When he came to his father, he said to him, 'Not only did they not bless us, they even caused us distress!' And he related their words to him, and his father explained to him that they were all great blessings.

And in Yevamot 15b we find that there was a great family in Jerusalem, of the house of Akhmai. Hyman criticizes Seder HaDorot for mixing all three together and wondering at this without recognizing that one was a disciple of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai and he is ben Asmai, and one a colleague of Rabbi Chanina and he is ben Akhinai, and one a disciple of Rabbi Yochanan and he is ben Akhmai.

notes.text: Hyman distinguishes Asmai, Akhinai and Akhmai by their teachers. He reports the apparently adverse blessings and says that the father interpreted all of them as blessings, without giving those explanations here.

The inspected student-farewell and blessing story runs from Moed Katan 9a into 9b. The full witness also includes תיפוק ולא תעייל and the father’s detailed explanations; Hyman elides that material, and it is not inserted into his translation. His Asmai/Akhinai/Akhmai distinctions by teachers and reported Ein Yaakov, Dikdukei Soferim and Tanchuma spellings remain his; those exact editions were not inspected.
